expected: A failed start leaves RecoveryRequired and keeps the exact borrowed pointer. quiet0 completion returns PENDING and cannot feed the watchdog. Successful quiescence permits one release and one normal completion watchdog event.
independent_procedure: Inject start failure after the model retains a buffer, repeated failed quiescence, successful recovery, completion with quiet0 and duplicate completion. Count watchdog and release events; reject premature-release and quiet-check omission mutants.
scope: Original local teaching program; finite anchor, no mastery or physical claim.
